title: Assigning a library skill changes what the next turn sees
behavior: With features.skillsLibrary on, a turn before assignment lists the library skill only among the skills on offer to every bot; after the Skills surface's assignment PUT, the next turn's system prompt carries it as the bot's own skill and no longer as an offer.
